title: Provide actual in-app download links for Android APK and iOS IPA

requirements.text: Add the built mobile wrapper artifacts to the exact static paths expected by the app so the Downloads screen can show real, working download links: `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` (served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`).
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` exists in the repo/build output and is served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` with an HTTP 200/OK response to a HEAD request.
`frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` exists in the repo/build output and is served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` with an HTTP 200/OK response to a HEAD request.
Visiting `/downloads` shows enabled download buttons for both artifacts (no 'not available yet' instructions).
Clicking the Android download button downloads a file named `SafeSpace.apk`.
Clicking the iOS download button downloads a file named `SafeSpace.ipa`.

requirements.text: On the `/downloads` page, when an artifact is available, display a visible, copyable direct URL for each artifact in addition to the download button (e.g., `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`).
acceptanceCriteria: When Android artifact is available, the page shows the direct URL string `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` in the UI.
When iOS artifact is available, the page shows the direct URL string `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` in the UI.
The displayed URLs can be selected and copied from the page (not only accessible via button click).

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing components instead).
nonGoals: Implementing signed production builds for App Store / Google Play distribution
Setting up third-party hosting/CDN for artifacts
Adding backend endpoints to serve or stream artifacts (artifacts must remain static frontend assets)
